Data and business analytics, with a finance background. I like turning messy data into clear recommendations, and this site collects the projects that show how I work.

Based in Irvine, CA, and looking at data analyst and business analyst roles in Orange County and San Diego.

## Projects

### [Search Relevance Engine](https://github.com/nathacia/search-relevance-engine)
A from-scratch TF-IDF search engine in Python, evaluated on the Home Depot Product Search Relevance dataset from Kaggle.

### [Hybrid Search and RAG](https://github.com/nathacia/hybrid-search-rag)
Compares from-scratch TF-IDF with OpenAI embeddings on real product data, then extends it into a full RAG pipeline with grounded LLM-generated answers.

### [Stroke Prediction with Decision Trees](https://github.com/nathacia/decisiontree-stroke)
A decision tree classifier in R that predicts stroke likelihood, with train/test evaluation, cross-validation-guided pruning, and full precision, recall, and F1 metrics.

More work is on my [GitHub](https://github.com/nathacia).
